identity.title: Connect deterministic height-grid region detection to 3D Studio

origin.summary: The owner asked to continue development while maximum-C3D performance qualification remains blocked; G-11 is dependency-ready after D-04 and C-06, and the local Vision SDK already contains the committed connected-region tools.

state.current_summary: The bounded G-11 software slice is implemented and verified: the exact vendored SDK package provides connected-region labeling and metrics; Studio validates and maps an immutable source-bound C3D mask; Runner verification covers deterministic output and fail-closed contracts.

objective.summary: Make deterministic connected-region labeling and source-grid metrics executable from OpenVisionLab 3D Studio over a C3D height buffer and an explicit boolean mask without duplicating SDK arithmetic or implying a persisted region artifact.
constraints: Use the exact clean local SDK source commit that owns ConnectedRegionTool and ConnectedRegionMetricsTool; create a unique local development package before Studio consumes it.
Keep numerical labeling, area, centroid, orientation, and bounds arithmetic in the Vision SDK; Studio owns source identity, dimensions, unit/frame checks, strict adaptation, and evidence composition.

Use an explicit source-bound boolean mask as the only mask input; do not invent polygon/circle rasterization, threshold policy, region-artifact persistence, or downstream inspection consumers in this slice.
Fail closed on null, empty, mismatched, stale, or invalid source/mask contracts and preserve source immutability.
Do not change product version, create a release, publish a package externally, commit, push, or modify the 2D reference repository.
Keep generated test and package evidence under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab-3D-Studio.

criteria.text: The exact clean SDK package exposes ConnectedRegionTool and ConnectedRegionMetricsTool with deterministic row-major region/cell ordering and source-neutral results, and its package metadata/hash identifies one immutable local development package.

A Studio-owned typed adapter accepts an exact C3D source snapshot plus an exact source-bound boolean mask, validates identity/dimensions/finite geometry, delegates labeling and metrics to the SDK, and does not reproduce region arithmetic.

A deterministic Runner verification covers separated four-neighbor regions, diagonal four-versus-eight behavior, source/mask immutability, area/centroid/bounds/orientation mapping, and fail-closed malformed contracts without fabricating a result.
The focused Studio verification, current Release build, relevant structure/ownership guard, and git diff --check pass; no UI, recipe, package publication, product version, commit, or push is claimed.

context.summary: The SDK owns source-neutral row-major connected-region labeling and cancellation-aware traversal.
The SDK owns deterministic area, centroid, principal orientation, and cell-footprint bounds.
Studio owns immutable C3D dimensions, source identity, frame/unit metadata, and copied values.
Runner owns deterministic source-bound adapter verification and report output.

evidence.observation: The vendored OpenVisionLab.Vision3D package verifier passed with exact package ID OpenVisionLab.Vision3D, version 3.0.1-dev.20260826.domain-mask.1, source commit db8b8a281dd028c62fabfc49febcde9b4d345d37, SHA-256 D87570212D4C8913360CB01D20D9669720EDB6424B42C7FB790909EC8766D1CB, and netstandard2.0 target.

The Runner G-11 verification passed 10/10 cases: deterministic separated regions, row-major IDs/cells, SDK metric mapping, repeated content identity, source/mask immutability, Four-versus-Eight diagonal behavior, and fail-closed empty, source-mismatch, non-finite-foreground, and invalid-connectivity contracts.
The current OpenVisionLab.ThreeDStudio.slnx Release build completed with zero warnings and zero errors after the SDK package and G-11 adapter changes.
The Release no-build solution test run passed all 10 tests with zero failures and zero skipped tests.
The existing Vision SDK Runner verification passed 26/26 cases against the updated package, confirming the prior Studio SDK consumers remain compatible while the connected-region tools are consumed.

The current solution-set structure and ownership guard passed 68/68 checks, including Core/Data/Tools/Runner dependency boundaries, Vision SDK ownership, no new Studio numerical ownership, and Runner routing ownership.
git diff --check completed with exit code 0 and no whitespace error diagnostics for the current tracked diff.

events.summary: G-11 bounded source-bound connected-region adapter, exact SDK package consumption, deterministic Runner fixture, fail-closed contracts, Release/test/ownership verification, and evidence documentation are complete. G-12 remains a separate follow-up for user-facing output and selected overlay routing.
